description.en:
Tells whether a brightness fade started with CMND_BRIGHT_FADE is still in progress on a screen.
Screens use SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).
While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image), it checks the top and the bottom screen, whatever screen is asked.

true while the fade is in progress, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
